atomicity.CONSUMED_inspection_fixture: isolated signed historical record only; no successful consume
atomicity.issuance: construct and sign before one copy-on-write _STORE publication of permanent key plus signed ISSUED record

race_tests.consume_vs_invalidate: one INVALIDATED commit; consume is PROOF_UNRESOLVED or LEASE_INVALIDATED

atomicity.transition: authenticate/check/sign before one copy-on-write _STORE publication of target record

authentication.canonical_types: exact primitives, string dictionary keys, exact nested lists; no numeric/subclass aliases or nonfinite values
authentication.framing: domain + NUL + role + NUL + canonical UTF-8 JSON

completion_meaning: The additive pinned lifecycle owner is implemented and pure-validated against the frozen contract. No operational lease has been issued or consumed.
consume_behavior: Reauthenticate under lock, check ISSUED, reject PROOF_UNRESOLVED before signing or replacing state; no caller readiness inputs or bypass.

error_taxonomy.ACTIVATION_PRECONDITION_UNSATISFIED: a defined and authenticated consumer readiness prerequisite is false; no transition
error_taxonomy.DUPLICATE_LEASE_ISSUANCE: authenticated permanent one-shot key already has a lease or tombstone
error_taxonomy.LEASE_ALREADY_CONSUMED: specific LEASE_NOT_ISSUED condition: authentic current state CONSUMED
error_taxonomy.LEASE_INVALIDATED: specific LEASE_NOT_ISSUED condition: authentic current state INVALIDATED
error_taxonomy.LEASE_NOT_ISSUED: parent category for authentic terminal source states only; forged or unknown state is LEASE_UNAUTHENTICATED
error_taxonomy.LEASE_UNAUTHENTICATED: wrong exact lease type, nonoriginal/copy/reconstruction, missing live identity, signature or record-integrity failure, forged or unknown record state, or wrong supplied upstream object; exact semantic scenario/policy mismatches use PINNED_AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH and provider projection mismatch uses PINNED_PROVIDER_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH
error_taxonomy.LEASE_WRONG_PROCESS: current PID differs from owner or authenticated lease PID; reject before inherited lock
error_taxonomy.PINNED_AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH: upstream public scope mismatch or exact scenario/policy scope mismatch; never relabeled authentication failure
error_taxonomy.PINNED_AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED: wrong upstream exact type, missing original registry object, rejected signature/process/binding; preserve upstream code and reason
error_taxonomy.PINNED_PROVIDER_PROVENANCE_MISMATCH: public provider/graph/proof-only or exact requirement/image/sandbox/controller/cleanup projection mismatch; preserve upstream code and reason
error_taxonomy.PROOF_UNRESOLVED: required consumer evidence owner/classification/API not established, unavailable or unexpected validator error; no permissive fallback or transition

authentication.canonical_json: sorted keys, compact separators, allow_nan=false; exact primitive and nested types
authentication.explanation: Public role-framed digests are deterministic projection identifiers. They do not independently authenticate capability. Independent secret HMAC, exact live lease identity and mandatory original upstream validation provide authentication.
authentication.framing: domain + NUL + role + NUL + UTF-8 canonical JSON
authentication.private_record_binding: immutable issuance projection including public digests and authenticated current state

confirmed_by_source: Distinct exact owner, type and schema; independent secret, owner lock, maps and record types
Mandatory unchanged public pinned validator must return the exact original upstream
Every valid lease operation reauthenticates the retained upstream and recomputes scenario, provider and policy projections under the owner lock
All fifteen frozen public provider projection fields are bound; no caller provider or private upstream registry access
Wrong process rejection precedes owner lock acquisition
Strict primitive and nested types reject equality aliases before canonical JSON serialization
Copy-on-write store replacement installs permanent issuance key and signed lease record at one publication point
Strong original upstream retention and weak live lease identity preserve permanent authorization tombstones after collection
Stable issuance fingerprint excludes mutable current state; current state is separately HMAC-authenticated
Only ISSUED, CONSUMED and INVALIDATED exist, with terminal transition replacement after all checks and signing
Consumption has no caller readiness override and fails closed with PROOF_UNRESOLVED
Invalidation does not require consumer readiness, and preserves the permanent issuance key
Authentic terminal state inspection remains available while retained upstream authenticates; readiness flags are false for terminal states
Authentication, scope, provider provenance and unresolved proof retain distinct typed categories; public ERROR_CODES enumerates all eleven frozen categories without introducing a consumer gate
All seventeen frozen broad authority flags remain false, including compilation; reflection acceptance is not claimed

historical_stage_assertion.observation: One assertion expects the future owner module to be absent. This describes the historical contract-freeze stage and cannot remain true in the implementation tree.
historical_stage_assertion.reporting_requirement: Preserve frozen bytes and disclose historical-view validation or current-tree failure; do not represent a patched existence view as an unmodified current-tree pass

one_shot_key.normative_explanation: The frozen contract document at lines 123-125 explicitly says the five-field tuple is from the original pinned authorization. These are upstream identities.
one_shot_key.source: exact original authorization returned by the mandatory public validator

resolved_advisory.issue: Validate generated lease ID shape before publishing any issuance record
resolved_advisory.resolution: Generated and collision-retried IDs now require exact lowercase 64-character hexadecimal strings; malformed generation raises PROOF_UNRESOLVED before publication

invalidation_behavior: Reauthenticate original lease/upstream and scenario/provider/policy/current state under lock; sign INVALIDATED and replace exactly once without consumer readiness; no reissue, consume, refund or reset.
isolated_tests: Source-loaded new owner and pinned upstream copies with an inert exact-original public validator seam. No provider graph, production registry seeding or production validator patching. No fixture capability is exported.
old_owner_isolation: All historical bytes preserved; independent type, secret, lock and owner store; unchanged production validators/registries/policies; no compatibility bridge.

one_shot_key.source: exact original pinned authorization returned by unchanged public validator

rejection_matrix.Boolean_JSON_readiness_override: TypeError or exact-original typed rejection; never a transition
rejection_matrix.authorization_copy_deepcopy_replace_manu: PINNED_AUTH_UNAUTHENTICATED or distinct authenticated scope error

runtime_activation_consumed: derived only from authenticated current state == CONSUMED

CONSUMED.validation: same original lease if upstream still authenticates

INVALIDATED.validation: same original lease if upstream still authenticates

stop_boundary: Implementation and pure validation complete. No live authorization/provider/lease attempt.

frozen_safe_after.excluded_stage_snapshot: Frozen contract-phase snapshot asserted the additive owner file did not exist before implementation. Baseline ran the full safe selection. After implementation excludes only that phase-stage assertion; frozen test bytes and all semantic assertions remain unchanged.

initial_implementation_run.reason: Race-test instrumentation counted record signature verification as terminal commits; corrected to assert actual owner-store publication. No consumer gate or implementation semantics changed.
